notes: INFO: SALARY MODEL: conglobated (minimi tabellari conglobati — contingenza and EDR fully absorbed). Back-calculation: May 2024 L3=1379.00/173=7.97 EUR/h; L2=1454.58/173=8.41 EUR/h; L1=1592.29/173=9.20 EUR/h — consistent divisor confirms conglobated model (lexplain.it + ilccnl.it).

INFO: TRANCHE DATES: four tranches — 2024-05-01 (retroactive, renewal signed 20 May 2024), 2025-01-01, 2026-01-01, 2026-10-01. Source: studiomion.it salary tables; cross-checked ilccnl.it for Jan 2026 values.
INFO: HOURLY DIVISOR: 173, derived from 40-hour work week (Art. 12 CCNL). Formula: 40 h/week × 52/12 = 173.33, rounded to 173 per contract usage. Confirmed: 1379.00/7.97=173.0 (L3 May 2024).
INFO: ADDITIONAL MONTHS: 13 (tredicesima only). Source: ilccnl.it Art. 40; informaimpresa.it ('tredici mensilità' explicitly stated as basis for Responsabile Tecnico allowance calculation).

INFO: SENIORITY: biennale (every 24 months), maximum 5 scatti. Per-level amounts: L1=9.30, L2=8.26, L3=7.75, L4=7.23 EUR/scatto. Source: ilccnl.it (current database), cross-checked CISL 2013 PDF (amounts unchanged by 2024 renewal, which only introduced a 6 EUR apprentice-specific scatto).

INFO: APPRENTICESHIP: Gruppo 1 modelled (acconciatori, estetisti, tricologi, tatuatori → destination level 3, max 5 years). Primary source: confartigianato Marca Trevigiana official PDF (ccnl-benessere-app.prof-fino-30.9.24.pdf) for pre-Oct-2024 table. Post-Oct-2024 update (filcams.cgil.it + fisascat.it): first-year percentages raised to 70% minimum. Pre-Oct-2024 Gruppo 1 months 1-12=65%, 13-18=70%; post-Oct-2024 months 1-12 raised to 70%, making months 1-18 uniformly 70%. Engine models post-Oct-2024 table: 0-18mo=70%, 18-24mo=78%, 24-36mo=85%, 36-48mo=90%, 48-54mo=95%, 54+mo=100%.

SIMPLIFICATION: APPRENTICESHIP GRUPPO 2: Gruppo 2 (manicure/pedicure → level 3, max 18 months: 70%/80%/100%) not modelled. Engine supports one destination_level per contract; Gruppo 1 covers dominant worker category (hairdressers/aestheticians).

SIMPLIFICATION: APPRENTICESHIP GRUPPO 3: Gruppo 3 (administrative staff → level 2, max 36 months: 70%/70%/78%/85%) not modelled. Different destination level (2 vs 3) and shorter duration than Gruppo 1.

SIMPLIFICATION: APPRENTICESHIP DURATION (TAB.3): 6-month reduction for post-secondary qualification holders (Gruppo 1: 54 months max instead of 60) not modelled. Engine uses the standard 60-month table.

SIMPLIFICATION: APPRENTICE SENIORITY: apprentice-specific seniority increment (6 EUR/scatto, introduced by Art. 25 of 2024 renewal from Oct 2024) not modelled. Engine has no apprentice-specific seniority mechanism.

SIMPLIFICATION: RESPONSABILE TECNICO ALLOWANCE: monthly indemnity of 100 EUR × 13 mensilità for workers designated as Responsabile Tecnico (level 1 or 2, per employer designation) not modelled. Applies only to a subset of level-1/2 workers, not universally.

SIMPLIFICATION: PRE-MAY-2024 SALARY: periods before 2024-05-01 not modelled. The 2022 CCNL renewal values (final tranche from 2023-02-01: L3=1309.00, L2=1380.74, L1=1511.46, L4=1234.19) are not included. Engine starts at the 2024 renewal's first retroactive tranche.
